theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_pc_cm_ofReal_integral_le_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U G : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (c : ℝ), MeasurableSet G → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), |g x| ≤ G.indicator (fun _ => c) x) → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * g x ∂μHE[n]) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * R.measure G
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
